name: TaylorSeer
plain: Instead of reusing old features, it forecasts them with a Taylor series built from finite differences at earlier computed steps, per block and module. Steps alternate between full computation every N steps and forecasted ones. Memory grows with block count unless the Lite node is used, which forecasts one tensor.
math:
Full step if step<first_enhance or counter=fresh_threshold−1 or step≥last_enhance.
On a full step: Δ⁰=f; Δ^{i+1} = (Δ^i − Δ^i_old)/d, d = steps between activations, up to max_order.
Forecast: f(x) = Σ Δ^i·xⁱ/i!, x = step − last full step.
Lite: once at stack output instead of each module.
